response.answer: Muhamad Rosyid Jazuli is a leading researcher on Indonesia's fuel subsidy reduction, focusing on political economy and discourse analysis. He has published extensively on the topic, emphasizing the complexities and implications of fuel subsidy reforms. His work critically examines the economic and social impacts of fuel subsidies.
